policy.adoption: The corpus is dev-only design reference. Nothing is vendored: adopted patterns are re-authored in Signals' words inside .claude/skills/signals-writing (spec §9.1, ADR-347-9).
policy.licensing: 62 of 63 skills declare no license, author, or copyright; humanizer declares MIT over content derived from a CC BY-SA 4.0 Wikipedia article without naming a copyright holder or documenting relicensing authority. All families are therefore redistribution not-cleared.
policy.heuristics: Every reach/timing/multiplier claim in the corpus is unsourced; adopted heuristics start at confidence=low with the corpus path as source and a reviewBy date (spec §5.10).
policy.exclusions: Platform-manipulation guidance (engagement-pod evasion, human-mimicry timing, detector gaming), personal identifiers, and named third parties' posts are never adopted (spec §9.5).
policy.packaging: docs-dev/refs is never copied into the RealTimeX plugin zip (scripts/package-realtimex-plugin.sh copies .claude/skills only).
